detailed_descriptions_html.en:
I always wanted an open-world survival craft game full of monster girls. Nobody had made one. So I did. That's this game.

Picture this. You wake up in your base at dawn and outside the window, the slime girl you caught last night is watering the crops. So what will today be? Dig deeper toward that ore vein? Push into the ruined downtown? Or raise the walls before the seventh night comes? Out here every day is yours to decide.

  • Monster girls brought to life in gorgeous animation
  • Voxel building on fully destructible terrain
  • Capture and befriend them - they work, live and fight with you
  • A horde raid every seven days, with rewards for holding the line
  • Hack-and-slash loot with randomized options
  • Play it your way - slow life or adventure

A modern city swallowed by another world

You know this scenery. Paved roads, rows of buildings, an abandoned convenience store. But mana crystals split the asphalt and something inhuman flickers past the broken windows. In 2040 the city fell to another world. Human civilization left its resources; the otherworld brought its magic. You survive on the seam between the two.

Dig, build, claim your kingdom

Start with a shack that keeps the rain off. It becomes a wall, then a tower, then a castle. Every block of terrain can be broken and placed anywhere. An underground fortress, a hideout carved into a mountain, a keep towering over the plains - build the blueprint in your head. Farm in peace or gear up and raid the ruins. Slow life or adventure, your call.

Live with monster girls

The locals here are monster girls. In the wild they are dangerous. Wear them down, capture them, and they join you - companions on the road, hands around the base, fighters at your side when night falls. Every one of them moves in beautiful animation. Sometimes you will stop working just to watch them. Honestly, that might be the real game.

A horde every seven days

On the seventh night the horde comes. Are the walls high enough? Traps set? Girls in position? Hold until morning and the rewards are yours. Broken walls can be rebuilt. Next week you will do it better.

Hack and slash your arsenal

Weapons and gear roll random options. No two drops are the same. Today's find beats yesterday's - tomorrow's might beat them both. Dig, hunt, open chests, and chase the perfect roll.

If you love block-mining games, this will hit. Except this one is very sexy.
If you love monster-collecting games, this will hit too. Except the sexy points a different way.
